subject: Vacation Request - December
body:
Hi HR Team,

I would like to request vacation time for the following dates:

Requested Dates: December 20-31, 2025
Total Days: 8 working days

Reason: Family holiday trip

I've ensured that all my current projects will be completed before my departure, and I've arranged for coverage during my absence.

Please let me know if this request is approved or if you need any additional information.

Thank you,
You
